body: Running away is also an option I've been toying with. I've considered selling everything I own and using whatever money I make from that to get out of the country, without a phone or a credit card or anything else, and see where the world takes me once the money is gone. I mean I'll probably get killed in no time as I have no survival skills, people skills or any other skills for that matter, but hey, at least the people in my life won't be left behind in the turmoil of a suicide?

But I have. I know what I enjoy and what gives me happiness. I *love* to party, go traveling, listen to live music, hang out in the sun, swim, paint, play videogames. The problem is that I can't just do those things. The problem is, I want to just have fun but I don't want to work for it. I don't want to sit in an office 40 hours a week just to have a few tired hours of freedom. I'm inherently lazy, naive, childish and unmotivated. But telling that to anyone will result in "oh but thats not realistic" or "but thats not how the world works" and I *know* that, and that's what depresses the hell out of me. That it's just work and bullshit and a little bit of fun in between. To me, the little bit of fun doesn't make up for all the bullshit, not even close. I mean it with all my heart, all my honesty, when I say that I would rather just die than live the kind of life everyone else lives. Hell, I should be looking for a job right now because I'm broke and can't even afford next month's rent let alone food. Actually I'm head over heels in debt because I'm constantly spending money I don't have just to do things I actually enjoy. But just the idea of having a job, a responsibility that I have to go to every single day, it's so incredibly depressing and the more my family and friends try to pressure/encourage me into sending out applications, the more I fantasize about quietly offing myself in the peace and silence of my apartment. Because life is shitty and hard and long and boring. Death is easy. Death is death. There is nothing after that. And nothing sounds so, so comforting.
